atlas.description: Deterministic simulation runtime: processes, filesystem, network and browser, replayable byte for byte.

files.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

1. No wall clock, no ambient RNG, no host I/O. Time is the tick you were handed.
2. Integer arithmetic only: money in cents, coordinates in micro-degrees.
3. Anything unordered - a HashMap, a thread, a directory listing - is a bug
   waiting for a Windows runner to find it. See issue #14.
files.README.md:
# Atlas

Atlas runs a whole simulated machine - processes, filesystem, network, browser -
from a seed, and replays it byte for byte.

Same seed, same inputs, same bytes out.

- Handbook: http://intranet.internal/
- Walkthrough: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough
- Status: http://status.northstar.example/
- Product: http://northstar.example/product

9.title: Document the seeded determinism streams
9.body: Every service draws from service/{id}/initialize, so insertion order does not perturb anyone else. That is worth a paragraph in CONTRIBUTING.md.
9.author: praman

14.title: BFS path test fails on Windows only
14.body: tests/path.rs is green on Linux and macOS and red on the Windows runner, about one run in four. Same seed, same inputs. Repro gist: http://github.com/gist/flaky-repro
14.author: bmartinez

comments.author: alicechen
comments.body: Smells like hash-map iteration order - src/bfs.rs walks links.get(at) straight out of a HashMap.

comments.author: praman
comments.body: It is. I wrote the long version here: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/t-4411

18.title: Publish a determinism explainer for the launch
18.body: The launch checklist wants one page a reader can send to a sceptic. Draft lives in the launch doc: http://docs.google.com/documents/atlas-launch
18.author: cnakamura

15.title: Sort refs before iterating in BFS
15.body: Swap the HashMap for a BTreeMap so neighbour order is part of the contract. Closes #14.
15.author: praman

comments.author: bmartinez
comments.body: Ran it 200 times on the Windows matrix. Green every time.

reviews.author: alicechen
reviews.body: Exactly right. The map was never the fast path anyway.

15.head: refs/heads/sort-refs

atlas-actions.description: Reusable CI workflows, including the Windows matrix that keeps catching hash-order bugs.

files.README.md:
# atlas-actions

The workflows every Northstar repository imports.

The `windows` job runs each test 20 times. See http://github.com/northstar/atlas/issues/14 for why.
files.workflows/windows.yml:
name: windows
jobs:
  test:
    runs: 20
    shell: powershell

7.title: Windows runner times out on a cold cache
7.body: First run after a cache eviction takes 19 minutes and trips the 15 minute limit.
7.author: bmartinez
